name: a0
description: Write, check, run and compile A0 programs through revision-checked structured edits.
long_description: A0 is a programming language built for AI. This extension runs the `a0 mcp` stdio server over one folder you choose: agents open a function view with a handle, apply edits that are checked before they land, run the reference interpreter, and emit native, wasm, JavaScript, JVM, .NET, GPU or SystemVerilog output. Paths are confined to the chosen folder, no shell is run, and nothing is sent over the network.

tools.name: a0_open
tools.description: Open a function view with a revision handle.

tools.name: a0_program
tools.description: Program handle, optionally scoped to a target.

tools.name: a0_apply
tools.description: Apply an edit under a handle; returns the new view or a diagnostic with a fix.

tools.name: a0_check
tools.description: Validate the program: one line per function with its revision.

tools.name: a0_run
tools.description: Run a function in the fuel-bounded reference interpreter.

tools.name: a0_emit
tools.description: Emit code for any target (arm64, c, wasm, js, java, dotnet, metal, sv).

tools.name: a0_save
tools.description: Write the program to disk after a successful apply.

root.title: A0 project folder
root.description: Folder (or .a0 file's folder) the server may read and write. Paths outside it are rejected.
